Lok aastha ke mahaparv men sabse jyada bikri bans ke sup ki hoti hai. bans ke sup men hi sury devta ko arghy diya jata hai. samay badla lekin yah paranpra aaj bhi kayam hai. mana jata hai ki bans, vansh ka pratik hai, vahi bans samajik samrasta ka bhi pratik mana jata hai.
